question.text: A trading member wants to conduct proprietary and client trading with 3 algorithmic trading strategies. What is the total BMC requirement?

answer.text: Rs. 1,25 lakhs (Rs. 50 lakhs + Rs. 25 lakhs x 3)

explanation.text: The Logic: The workbook BMC table has a single category for "All Brokers with Algo" at Rs. 50 lacs. The source does not provide a per-algo add-on; once the member is in the "with algo" tier, the BMC is Rs. 50 lakhs irrespective of the number of algo strategies. The Trap: The other options assume an additive per-algo amount (for example, Rs. 25 lakhs per strategy). That structure is not in the source table, so totals like Rs. 75 lakhs, Rs. 125 lakhs and Rs. 150 lakhs are not supported. Note: Source-backed to NISM-Series-IV workbook (Dec 2025), pages 289-290; the per-algo add-on was not found on the pages checked.
